user.title: Add a project
user.description: Monitor a project using its integration domain, its public GitHub repository, or both. The examples use Community Stats itself. The monitored project does not have to be installed locally.

data.discover_repository: Suggest a GitHub repository from the installed integration

data_description.integration_domain: Example: community_stats. Use the integration’s technical name, not its display name “Community Stats”. Leave empty for a dashboard card or GitHub statistics only.
data_description.repository: Example: SoftwareSchmied/community-stats or {repository_example_url}. Use the project’s GitHub address, not a local HACS address. Leave empty for installation statistics only.
data_description.analytics_source: For Community Stats: Custom integration or Detect automatically. Core integrations provide totals without their own version distribution. Selecting a source explicitly also allows domains that are not yet reported.
data_description.discover_repository: Suggest the repository of a locally installed integration. Review the mapping in the next step.
data_description.access_token: Optional; public projects need no write permissions. Without a token, projects share a queue: the next one runs every 61 minutes. With a token, the configured interval applies.

integration.title: Select an integration in the repository

project.title: Review sources and configure sensors

data.name: Project name
data.top_versions: Number of top versions to discover per source
data.include_prereleases: Include prereleases in new top-version selections

data_description.name: Choose a device name, for example Community Stats.
data_description.top_versions: Example: 10 discovers the ten versions with the highest installation or download counts. Range: 1–100. Previously tracked versions continue to update.
data_description.include_prereleases: Include beta versions when selecting new top versions. Previously tracked versions and totals are unaffected.
data_description.update_interval: Example: 12 means every twelve hours. Range: 1–168 hours. Applies to Analytics and GitHub with a token. Without a token, the next GitHub project is updated every 61 minutes.
data_description.asset_patterns: Community Stats example: community_stats.zip. This is the name of a file attached to GitHub releases. *.zip counts all ZIP files. Enter one filename or pattern per line. Empty: no download sensors; stars, forks, watchers and issues remain active.

error.project_required: Enter an integration domain or a GitHub repository.
error.invalid_domain: Use the integration domain, with lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
error.invalid_repository: Enter owner/repository or a valid HTTPS GitHub repository URL.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Try again later.
error.invalid_data: The source returned an unexpected data format.
error.not_found: The requested GitHub repository or file was not found, or is not accessible.
error.rate_limited: GitHub's request budget is exhausted. Wait for it to reset, or configure a token.
error.invalid_auth: GitHub rejected the token. Check or remove it.
error.access_denied: GitHub denied access to this resource.
error.repository_moved: The GitHub repository moved. Enter its current owner/name.
error.core_repository: Core integration downloads cannot be separated from Home Assistant Core. Leave the repository empty.
error.no_matching_assets: No release files match the selected patterns.

init.title: Project settings
init.description: Change the selection and updates for your project. Previously tracked version sensors are retained. Changing the repository or filename patterns starts new download series.
